page.overview:
Who is Alkon?

Alkon Distillery (Russian: ОАО «Алкон») is a Russian company which produces various alcohol products, vodkas, nastoykas, nalivkas and balsams. The company is one of the oldest distilleries in the country, founded in 1897.
